title: Site roll-up
description: The machine-readable index of the whole site, generated from every report.json. Nothing here is scraped from a rendered page. That is the guarantee that makes site-level figures checkable: a claim that exists only in a page's prose cannot become a site-level number, because no code path reads prose.

metrics.description: Derived from the report records and rendered directly as the landing page tiles. Derive them; never maintain them. Any source hub page that shows totals must apply the same rules, or a hub and the landing page disagree while reading the same manifests.

reviewed.description: Reports a person has judged, as distinct from published.

usable_hours.description: Sums only reports that record an hours figure, and a report wholly inside another over the same sites contributes nothing, because its hours are already counted. Hours cannot be unioned the way days are: usable_hours is a sum over nodes, not a duration. Reports whose coverage is counted another way contribute nothing here, so this is a floor rather than a total.

days_covered.description: Distinct calendar days that any report carries data for. A union, not a sum: four reports covering the same day count it once.

reports.description: Ordered newest data first: by period.end descending, then period.start, with the members of a series kept contiguous in their stated order. Publish date does not move a report, so a backfill published today about a week last month sits with last month.

coverage.description: Coverage as a phrase, because the unit differs by domain: hours of usable signal for audio, source segments or frames for video. Rendered, not computed on.

period.description: When the report's data is from, as distinct from generated_at, which is when it was published. This is the landing page's sort key. source says where the dates came from: the manifest window, or a date read from the title, series name or report id when the window is null, or the publish date as a last resort. Anything other than window is shown as inferred.
